pages.text: $(thing)Incendium$() rebuilds the Nether. It adds new biomes, mobs, structures and loot, so the Nether plays differently from vanilla.

Its biomes include Infernal Dunes, Inverted Forest, Quartz Flats, Toxic Heap, Volcanic Deltas, Weeping Valley, Ash Barrens and Withered Forest. Structures include a Forbidden Castle, Infernal Altar, Nether Reactor, Piglin Village, Ruined Lab, Sanctum and Quartz Kitchen.

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Create's heat source. Loaded with a blaze from a Nether fortress spawner.

Other mods add to the Nether too. $(l:exploration/cataclysm)Cataclysm$(/l) has Nether bosses and arenas, and $(l:exploration/structure_packs)Dungeons and Taverns$(/l) adds Nether keeps, ports and skeleton towers.
The Nether is where Create's $(l:create_basics/heat)heat$(/l) starts: Blaze Burners are loaded with blazes from fortresses. Its ores are listed in the $(l:materials/ore_guide)Ore Guide$(/l).
